title: Sample-Efficient Control of Magnetoconvective Flows via Differentiable Simulation
abstract: arXiv:2611.18008v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Magnetohydrodynamic (MHD) fluid flows are central to demanding engineering applications, most prominently fusion blanket cooling, where flow control is a promising tool to optimize key properties such as heat transfer. While active flow control (AFC) has recently advanced through machine learning, its application to MHD flows remains largely unexplored. In this work, we present $\phi$-PICT, a novel differentiable GPU-accelerated MHD solver targeted at AFC. We validate $\phi$-PICT against MHD benchmarks and demonstrate its high computational efficiency. Integrated into FluidGym, $\phi$-PICT enables sample-efficient gradient-based algorithms to improve heat transfer by $>25$% and allows optimizers to achieve $10^3\times$ higher accuracy in inverse design than black-box methods. $\phi$-PICT is publicly available at https://github.com/upb-sciml/phiPICT.

translated_title: 基于可微模拟的磁对流流动样本高效控制
translated_abstract: 磁流体动力学（MHD）流体流动在要求苛刻的工程应用中处于核心地位，最突出的是聚变包层冷却，其中流动控制是优化传热等关键特性的一种有前景的工具。虽然主动流动控制（AFC）近来已通过机器学习取得进展，但其在MHD流动中的应用在很大程度上仍未被探索。在这项工作中，我们提出了φ-PICT，这是一种针对AFC的新型可微分GPU加速MHD求解器。我们通过MHD基准测试验证了φ-PICT，并展示了其高计算效率。集成到FluidGym中后，φ-PICT使样本高效的基于梯度的算法能够将传热提高25%以上，并使优化器在逆向设计中比黑盒方法获得10³倍的更高精度。φ-PICT已在 https://github.com/upb-sciml/phiPICT 公开提供。
tldr: 本文提出φ-PICT，一种面向主动流动控制的可微分GPU加速磁流体动力学求解器，可将传热提升25%以上，并在逆向设计中实现比黑盒方法高10³倍的精度。
en_tdlr: This paper presents φ-PICT, a differentiable GPU-accelerated MHD solver for active flow control, enabling over 25% heat transfer improvement and 10³× higher inverse design accuracy than black-box methods.
